title: Who the controller is
msg: No controller named. Art. 13(1)(a) requires the identity of the controller — the legal entity, not just a product name.

title: Contact details of the controller
msg: No contact details. Art. 13(1)(a) requires contact details of the controller — an address or a mailbox a person can actually write to.

title: Data protection officer
msg: No DPO contact. Art. 13(1)(b) requires it where a DPO is designated; say so explicitly if you have not designated one.

title: Purposes of the processing
msg: No stated purposes. Art. 13(1)(c) requires the purposes of the processing for which the personal data are intended.

title: Legal basis for each purpose
msg: No legal basis. Art. 13(1)(c) requires the legal basis for the processing — consent, contract, legal obligation, vital interests, public task or legitimate interests.

title: Recipients of the data
msg: No recipients. Art. 13(1)(e) requires the recipients or categories of recipients of the personal data.

title: Transfers outside the EEA
msg: No transfer disclosure. Art. 13(1)(f) requires you to say whether personal data go to a third country — including your US hosting and analytics vendors.

title: Safeguard for the transfer
msg: No safeguard named. Art. 13(1)(f) requires reference to the appropriate safeguards under Art. 46 and how to obtain a copy of them.

title: A retention period in real units
msg: No retention period. Art. 13(2)(a) requires the storage period or the criteria to determine it — "as long as necessary" alone is not a criterion.

title: All six data subject rights
msg: Rights list incomplete. Art. 13(2)(b) requires access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability and objection to be named. Missing:

title: Right to withdraw consent
msg: No withdrawal right. Art. 13(2)(c) requires the right to withdraw consent at any time, and Art. 7(3) says it must be as easy to withdraw as to give.

title: Right to complain to a supervisory authority
msg: No complaint route. Art. 13(2)(d) and Art. 77 require the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority.

title: Whether giving the data is required
msg: Art. 13(2)(e) requires you to say whether providing the data is a statutory or contractual requirement and what happens if the person does not provide it.

title: Automated decisions and profiling
msg: Art. 13(2)(f) requires disclosure of automated decision-making, including profiling — say "we do not carry out automated decision-making" if you do not.

title: A dated, current notice
msg: No date on the notice. Transparency under Art. 12(1) is judged against what you were doing at the time — an undated notice proves nothing.

title: Template placeholder still in the text
msg: Placeholder left in a published notice — Art. 12(1) requires the information to be concise, transparent and intelligible.
